subtitle: 销量王座易主
summary: 卡普空公布的最新数据表明，《生化危机2重制版》以1,975万份销量超过《生化危机5》的1,901万份，成为系列最畅销作品。系列累计销量达2.13亿份，略高于《最终幻想》的2.12亿份；《生化危机：安魂曲》与《生化危机4重制版》也仍在热卖。
opus_summary: 卡普空称，《生化危机2重制版》以1,975万份销量超越《生化危机5》的1,901万份，成为系列最畅销作品。系列累计销量达2.13亿份，略高于《最终幻想》的2.12亿份；《生化危机：安魂曲》已售800万份。

paragraphs.en: After 15 years, Resident Evil 5 is no longer the highest-selling entry in Capcom's survival horror series, the publisher has revealed.
paragraphs.cn: 卡普空透露，时隔15年，《生化危机5》已不再是这家发行商旗下生存恐怖系列中销量最高的作品。

paragraphs.en: New sales figures for the Resident Evil franchise show its sales crown has now been taken by the Resident Evil 2 remake, which has now shifted 19.75 million copies — enough to slip past Resident Evil 5's final total of 19.01 million.
paragraphs.cn: 《生化危机》系列最新销量数据显示，系列销量王冠如今已由《生化危机2重制版》摘得；该作累计售出1,975万份，足以超过《生化危机5》最终的1,901万份。

paragraphs.en: These totals are interesting for several reasons. Firstly, the fact that Resi 5's sales have taken a decade and a half to topple says a lot about the huge excitement for that game when it initially arrived — riding on the coat tails of the beloved original Resi 4, despite ultimately being judged as nowhere near as good.
paragraphs.cn: 这些数字有几层值得玩味之处。首先，《生化危机5》的销量花了15年才被超越，充分说明它刚推出时引发了多大的热潮——尽管它最终被评价为远不如备受喜爱的《生化危机4》原作，但仍借后者的余势获得关注。

paragraphs.en: Secondly, these totals show that the Resident Evil series' back catalogue continues to sell really well. Capcom's Resident Evil 2 remake launched back in 2019 and is clearly still shifting copies (and has likely benefited from the subsequent launches of other Leon S. Kennedy-starring titles such as the Resi 4 remake and Resident Evil Requiem ).
paragraphs.cn: 其次，这些数字表明《生化危机》系列的旧作目录仍卖得很好。卡普空的《生化危机2重制版》早在2019年推出，显然至今仍在持续销售；而《生化危机4重制版》《生化危机：安魂曲》等同样由Leon S. Kennedy担纲的后续作品推出，可能也令它受益。

paragraphs.en: Speaking of the Resi 4 remake and Requiem, you might wonder where their sales are in all of this. Well, they are still selling brilliantly, too — and may yet both eclipse Resident Evil 2 to become the franchise's top sellers, given enough time.
paragraphs.cn: 说到《生化危机4重制版》和《生化危机：安魂曲》，你或许会好奇它们在这些数据中的表现。它们同样卖得出色；假以时日，两作都有可能超过《生化危机2重制版》，成为系列销量最高的作品。

paragraphs.en: Resident Evil Requiem has now sold 8 million copies, a figure that will undoubtedly rise far further as the game gets discounted over time and receives its highly-anticipated post-launch expansion. Resident Evil 4's remake, meanwhile, is now on an impressive 16 million copies sold.
paragraphs.cn: 《生化危机：安魂曲》现已售出800万份；随着时间推移，游戏降价并推出备受期待的发售后扩展内容，这一数字无疑还会大幅增长。与此同时，《生化危机4重制版》的销量已达到令人瞩目的1,600万份。

paragraphs.en: All combined, the Resident Evil franchise has now sold a combined 213 million copies across all of its games — a figure which sees it edge past the 212 million total sales of Square Enix's Final Fantasy franchise, although these have not yet been updated for this financial quarter.
paragraphs.cn: 合计来看，《生化危机》系列所有游戏的累计销量现已达到2.13亿份，略高于史克威尔艾尼克斯《最终幻想》系列的2.12亿份总销量；不过，这些数据尚未更新至本财季。

paragraphs.en: Other Capcom games selling well include new franchise Pragmata (now up to 2.51 million copies sold) and Monster Hunter: World which has now sold an astonishing 30.45 million copies.
paragraphs.cn: 卡普空其他畅销游戏还包括新系列《识质存在》，其销量现已达到251万份；以及销量惊人的《怪物猎人：世界》，现已售出3,045万份。

paragraphs.en: Next up for the Resident Evil franchise is the launch of Zach Cregger's Resident Evil movie on September 16, before the arrival of Resident Evil Veronica sometime in 2027 .
paragraphs.cn: 《生化危机》系列接下来的动向，是Zach Cregger执导的《生化危机》电影将于9月16日上映，随后《生化危机维罗妮卡重制版》将在2027年的某个时候推出。
